paragraphs.text: Alsadim K'mer, the Sainted One was a cleric on Shandalar , who took command of the White Guild until its downfall.

Alsadim K'mer's forces included clerics , priestesses , crusaders , paladins , arch angels , high priests , lords of fate , winged stallios , centaur warchiefs , tusk guardians , and Kiska-Ra dragons .

The guildlords and the guilds themselves were originally of pure intent to defend Shandalar but were corrupted by the evil Planeswalker Arzakon 's influence in the guise of a benevolent advisor. Together, they betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar during Arzakon's War , to open the path for Arzakon.
The Guildlords, including Alsadim K'mer, were in turn defeated, and Arzakon was banned from entering the plane.
